documents.unit: UK ADVANCE (Office of the Provost generative AI committee)
documents.title: UK ADVANCE 2025 Guidelines and Recommendations for Generative AI in Instructional Contexts
documents.summary: Tier 4. University-wide guidance from UK's generative AI committee for instructors. It covers AI capabilities and risks (privacy, accuracy, learning, ethics), what an effective course AI policy should contain along a four-point spectrum from no use to free use, how to respond to suspected misuse, and assignment design. It recommends against using AI detectors to determine academic offenses.

documents.title: Suggested Syllabus Policies & Notices
documents.summary: Tier 4. UNC Charlotte's official suggested syllabus language, including two generative AI options (AI permitted in all work with attribution, or only on designated assignments). Both require disclosure and an acknowledgment statement, warn about data privacy, and the page explains that AI detection tools are designated do-not-use and require student consent if used anyway.

documents.unit: Office of the Provost / Academic Affairs (AI Working Group)
documents.title: Michigan Tech Syllabus Guidance
documents.summary: Tier 4. Three tiered syllabus templates from Michigan Tech's AI Working Group: general permission, conditional permission for listed assignments, and prohibition. Templates require transparency about AI use, keep students responsible for AI-caused errors, and treat unauthorized use as cheating.
